crossRefs.note: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and…
Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.
He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.
As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who…

parallels.note: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

people.name: Beth-horon_Lower
people.line: Town in Ephraim and Dan, site of a famous battle.

people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,
translations.bsb: So Solomon rebuilt Gezer, Lower Beth-horon,
translations.kjv: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
translations.asv: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,
